entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Oh, hello. I hope you can help. I bought these cycling shoes, and I... I think I need to send them back. I'm not sure how it works.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

I... I'm not sure. I couldn't figure out the cleats, they seemed so complicated. I wore them around my house for maybe ten minutes and I could already feel blisters forming. The whole thing is just confusing. Can't you just help me?

I'm very sorry to hear they were uncomfortable and causing blisters. That's definitely not the experience we want for you. I just need to ask for your order number or the email address you used to purchase, and I can check the return eligibility.
Okay, my email is confusedcustomer@email.com. I hope it's not too late. I get so lost trying to read the policies on the website.
Not a problem at all. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the cycling shoes were delivered 58 days ago.
Is that bad? I told you I wasn't sure about the rules.
No, that's perfectly fine. Our standard return policy is 90 days, so you are well within the window to make a return for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! So what do I do?

I've just initiated the return for you. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. All you need to do is put the shoes back in the box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, we'll process your refund.
Wow, that's so much easier than I thought. Thank you so much, Alex. You've been a huge help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
